programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
programs.sub_title: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programs.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programs.sub_title: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programs.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
programs.desc: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programs.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"
programs.desc: During the Vietnam War, the USAF learned most pilot losses happened in their first 10 missions, leading to intense training that saves lives.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"
programs.desc: At Fort Benning’s Army Combatives School, soldiers train in brutal hand-to-hand combat, learning real-world skills to fight and survive.
